scope_note: Fresh read-only review of final sandbox splf (before spon3) for 0001646614; supersedes 0001646614_sple.json. Scripts: scratch/fund_runs/0001646614/reviewer_sple/ (*_f.py, fdiff.py, cov_f.py, spcreh.py). Full-population re-scans on splf: printed industry (2,020 rows), printed currency (1,931), printed reference-rate code (1,930), bracketed cost, non-ASCII names. Field diff splf vs sple (2,072 rows each, none added or removed): issuer_name 7, cost 47, interest_rate 21, basis_spread / reference_rate_type / reference_rate_source / coupon_type 3, extracted_industry 2, gics_sub_industry 10, gics_sector 2, canonical_name / entity_id / position_id 5, plus the _reported and corrected_fields companions; every change matches a declared change. Not checked: non-accrual flags, acquisition dates and pct of net assets row by row; the 2026 cost residues; the 20-row random page sample. A clean ledger would not establish data correctness.
